overview: Enterprise-grade CRM for ThiruKochi Advisors, a Kerala-based finance/advisory company. Features role-based dashboards (Super Admin, Zonal Manager, Branch Manager, Staff), customer and employee management, advanced analytics, attendance tracking, transfer management, and a professional dark/light fintech UI.
features: Role-based dashboards with 4 distinct user roles
Customer management with KYC, EMI schedules, and payment history
Employee management with attendance, performance, and transfer tracking
Advanced analytics with Recharts — revenue, collection, branch comparison charts
Smart notifications system with multiple categories
Dark/light mode with smooth fintech-themed transitions
Mock data with realistic Kerala zones, branches, employees, and customers
Responsive enterprise layout with collapsible sidebar and top navbar
